scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic night photograph with the same camera and composition, Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Keep its landforms and props where they are, but none of its smooth surfaces survive: blob trees become real Aleppo pines and tall cypresses, smooth ground becomes real limestone, scree, scrub and dry grass. NIGHT under a full moon: cool blue moonlight, deep shadows, clear sky, no fire, no lamps. Shields are plain round bronze, no emblem or device. One small bleached-linen tent in a clearing, its shield leaning beside it; far above on the skyline the ruined cyclopean dry-stone ring wall of the crown. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its mercenary's dress exactly (oxblood red tunic and cloak, linen corslet, bronze greaves). He sits alone at the tent's mouth, hands on knees. No other people. Deep focus. Nothing modern.
